purpose: Pilot of the transaction runner (rc_tpcc.py): matched seeded inputs, scoped before/after capture, revert and exact re-verification, balanced order. Two blocks per transaction. Pilot records are never campaign data.

design.inputs: global random.seed(S) immediately before each call; S = first 48 bits of sha256("<protocol_id>:T<t>:<block>"); block 0 = cell warmup
design.state: before-image of every row the input can touch, read on a separate autocommit connection; after-image; committed difference; before-image written back; scope re-read and required equal; table row counts per block
design.clock_rule: present and within [min(client,db) start - 2 s, max(client,db) end + 2 s]; excluded from equality only
design.timer: perf_counter around the transaction function (commit inside); seeding, capture, revert, checks and the SQLAlchemy post-call rollback outside

acceptance: per block and framework: both calls ok; committed differences equal after clock-column handling; declared common outputs equal; keys equal to the replayed draws; both reverts verified; table counts unchanged
